settings.repere: Paragraphe · For years, you've been told it's the fur
settings.text: For years, you've been told it's the fur. But the truth is, the real trigger for your sneezes and sniffles is a microscopic protein called Fel d 1.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · This sticky allergen lives in your cat's
settings.text: This sticky allergen lives in your cat's saliva, and every time they groom, it coats their fur and spreads invisibly throughout your home. That's why even constant cleaning and air purifiers feel like a losing battle - you're fighting the wrong enemy.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Many cats resist diet changes
Paragraphe · Imagine a tiny 'switch' that could help
settings.text: Imagine a tiny 'switch' that could help dial down your cat's allergens. That's essentially what Buckley does. We harness a natural egg protein called IgY antibodies. When sprinkled on your cat's food, these antibodies bind to the Fel d 1 protein in their mouth - helping reduce how much spreads to their fur and into your home. Less active Fel d 1 can mean less sneezing, less guilt, and more cuddles.
